gear.definition_choice: uniform among the 36 definitions (20 weapons, 3 head/armor/garment/shoes, 4 accessories) of the stage tier; no class-specific armor
gear.rng: D-129: new frozen profiles roll50% gear chance each5min, then rarity/definition/options only on success; independent card attempt every5min regardless of gear. Missing frozen gear chance preserves legacy100% and draw order.
gear.full_inventory: reserve fixed pending claim and advance reservation cursor atomically; pay wallet/items only when space permits; retries do not reroll

supreme_analysis.interpretation: common-equivalent throughput bound for one desired definition, not expected time or guaranteed pity; integer fusion and rare drops require distribution simulation later

cards.roll_interval: One independent card chance every five-minute interval, even when gear does not drop; expected1.44–2.88 cards per12h unchanged.
cards.quality_and_grade: D-109: fixed Common weak / Uncommon strong / Rare Elite / Epic Mini / Legendary MVP; no per-copy quality roll, Immortal/Supreme disabled. chance1–2% unchanged. D-122 Puppet I: Rare, chapter3 plus tier40 gate, weight100; full MVP remains Legendary/chapter6/weight10.
cards.legacy: Preserve frozen v1/v2 chance/pool/quality roll for old accrual, normalize resulting monster rarity and keep legacy quality floor. New v3 profiles freeze per-definition rarities.
